data.description: Dependabot critical alerts #109 (GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4, RCE in the Image Optimization API with AVIF) and #110 (GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36, RCE on Windows-hosted servers) flag next >=16.0.0 <16.3.3 in web/package-lock.json. web/package.json and web/bun.lock already pin next 16.3.4 (patched), and CI's web-typecheck job installs with bun install --frozen-lockfile. The npm web/package-lock.json is stale at next 16.2.6: recent Dependabot group bumps (#426) updated bun.lock but not it. Work: determine which lockfile and install command the deployed web build actually uses (Vercel project settings, vercel.json, and code/platform/vercel.md); if the deployed build uses package-lock.json the live site may be running the vulnerable version, which changes the urgency and must be reported immediately. If package-lock.json is unused, remove it and make sure Dependabot and Vercel both key on bun.lock; otherwise regenerate it at 16.3.4. Verify bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun tsc --noEmit and bun run build locally; bun run lint already fails on main (C11-214), so only confirm no new lint errors. Confirm both alerts close after merge.
data.title: web: critical Next.js RCE alerts flag a stale npm package-lock (next 16.2.6) while bun.lock is already patched

data.body:
# C11-223 implementation plan

1. Establish the baseline and read the relevant repository/deployment contracts: `web/package.json`, `web/vercel.json` when present, `code/platform/vercel.md`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, and the `web-typecheck` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Query Dependabot alerts 109 and 110 for their current package/range evidence.
2. Determine the deployed install source before changing files. Inspect the Vercel project’s install command and framework settings through the documented Vercel API/CLI credentials, and reconcile those settings with `vercel.json` and the repository’s package-manager conventions. If deployment uses the stale npm lockfile, immediately notify the orchestrator that the deployed site may be on Next.js 16.2.6; record the finding either way.
3. Make the smallest lockfile fix that leaves one authoritative dependency path: remove `web/package-lock.json` when CI and Vercel do not use it, then update any Dependabot configuration needed to watch `bun.lock`; otherwise regenerate npm’s lockfile at Next.js 16.3.4 and verify both lockfiles resolve the patched version. Search for references so no build or automation path is silently left inconsistent.
4. Verify in `web/` with the exact required commands: `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, `bun tsc --noEmit`, and `bun run build`. Run `bun run lint` only to establish that the known five C11-214 failures remain unchanged and report whether any new lint failures appear. Do not run Xcode or tagged-app validation for this ticket.
5. Review the diff, commit the dependency/configuration change, push `web-next-lockfile-cve`, open a PR against `main`, and poll all PR checks to completion. Repair any failure, rebasing onto a moved `origin/main` when necessary. Once CI is green, move the ticket to `review` with `--no-auto-review`, post the full evidence report, and notify the orchestrator without merging or marking the ticket done. State which lockfile change is expected to close alerts 109 and 110 after merge.

# C11-223 completion report

## Change

- Deleted `web/package-lock.json`, the stale 8,000-line npm manifest resolving Next.js 16.2.6.
- Kept `web/bun.lock` as the sole web lockfile; `web/package.json` and `web/bun.lock` both pin Next.js 16.3.4.
- `.github/dependabot.yml` already watches the Bun ecosystem at `/web`, so no Dependabot configuration change was needed.
- Updated the historical `notes/c11-audit-20260609.md` entry so it no longer reports the resolved two-lockfile drift.

## Deployment finding

The documented Vercel credentials identify the Stage11 team as `stage11-9ae35561`. Read-only checks found no `c11`, `c11-web`, or `web` project, no `c11.stage11.systems` domain, no `web/vercel.json`, and no linked Vercel project metadata. `dig +short c11.stage11.systems` returned no address and `curl -sS -L --max-time 20 -D - -o /dev/null https://c11.stage11.systems` failed with curl error 6 (could not resolve host). Thus there is no authorized Stage11 Vercel deployment evidence that installs `web/package-lock.json`; the deployed-site exposure alert was not sent. The orchestrator should retain this benign/no-deployment finding in the final handoff.

Dependabot API detail at audit time: alerts #109 and #110 were both `open`, `critical`, for npm `next`, affected range `>= 16.0.0, < 16.3.3`, first patched version `16.3.3`, and manifest `web/package-lock.json` (GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4 and GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36; #110 also reports CVE-2026-75604). Removing that manifest is the change expected to close both alerts after merge. The remaining authoritative Bun lockfile is already patched at 16.3.4.

## Validation

- `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in `web/`: passed under Bun 1.3.14; `Checked 448 installs across 547 packages (no changes) [85.00ms]`.
- `bun tsc --noEmit` in `web/`: passed with exit 0 and no diagnostics.
- `RESEND_API_KEY=local-placeholder C11_FEEDBACK_FROM_EMAIL=build@example.com C11_FEEDBACK_TO_EMAIL=build@example.com C11_FEEDBACK_RATE_LIMIT_ID=local-test bun run build` in `web/`: passed with exit 0 under Next.js 16.3.4; compiled in 13.9s, TypeScript finished in 8.2s, and generated 407/407 static pages. Existing diagnostics reported missing `wallOfLove` metadata messages for non-English locales and the existing multiple-lockfile workspace-root warning, but the build completed successfully.
- `bun run lint` before and after the change: unchanged at 5 errors and 7 warnings, exit 1, matching the known C11-214 baseline. The five errors remain in `spacing-control.tsx` and `page.tsx`; no new lint errors were introduced.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- PR #439 checks: all terminal checks green — `web-typecheck`, `build`, `compat-tests (macos-15, 30, true, false)`, `drawbridge-judge`, `drawbridge-gate`, `drawbridge-review`, `drawbridge-notify`, `remote-daemon-tests`, `workflow-guard-tests`, and `build-ghosttykit`. `drawbridge-merge` was correctly skipped for this unmerged PR.
- Final freshness check: local/PR HEAD `74990a1092750d007082bc835ba96da32a3bd717`; `origin/main` and PR base `c0ed04c0850c61c9d849f2425e0dec1249f1eb14`; merge-base equals the base.

## Deliberate boundaries and follow-up

- No Xcode build, test action, tagged app, Vercel write, merge, or deployment was performed.
- After merge, verify that Dependabot alerts #109 and #110 close for removal of `web/package-lock.json`; do not treat the currently open pre-merge alert state as a failure of this PR.
- No skill sync is required because no skill source changed.

Commit: `74990a109` (`web: remove stale npm lockfile`)
PR: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/439

PASS. PR #439 squash-merged as c8e5a0a7b. Deleted the stale npm web/package-lock.json (next 16.2.6); web/bun.lock remains the single lockfile at next 16.3.4, which CI installs with --frozen-lockfile and Dependabot already watches. Delegator verified bun install, tsc and a full bun run build under 16.3.4, and lint unchanged at the C11-214 baseline. Deployment finding: no Stage 11 Vercel project or DNS for the c11 web app exists, so no live site was exposed. Orchestrator to confirm alerts #109 and #110 close.
